profile.org_note: Four reporting segments (West Coast, Southwest, Central, Southeast) over about 50 markets in 11 states. Below them sit regions led by Regional Presidents / Regional General Managers (East Region: Vince DePorre; Northern California: Oren Hershkovich; Coastal Southern California: Steve Ruffner; Las Vegas/Idaho: Aaron Hirschi; Texas likely Brett Dietz, Inferred), and divisions that run land acquisition locally with 'considerable autonomy' while corporate approves every land purchase and runs treasury centrally (FY2025 10-K). Since 1 Mar 2026 CEO Robert McGibney oversees all regional and division leaders and is interim principal financial officer (no CFO since 8 May 2026); Executive Chairman Jeffrey Mezger oversees land and capital-markets strategy; corporate land head Albert Praw (EVP Real Estate and Business Development) retires 30 Nov 2026 with no successor named; Thad Johnson remains Treasurer on 2026 state records. Division presidents are in kb-home.divisions.json.

profile.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH) is a large public homebuilder with about 50 markets in 11 states, built around a Built to Order model. It owned 57% and optioned 43% of its lots at FY2025 year end, after dropping 24,596 optioned lots that no longer met its underwriting, and it cut land spending in 2025 to buy back shares. In 2026 it entered Atlanta, said it will move its headquarters from Los Angeles to Tempe, AZ in spring 2027, and changed CEO. The CFO seat is open and the corporate land head retires at the end of November 2026, so land and finance contacts are changing.
